correctness.rationale: The three explicit dipole potentials satisfy the vertex Laplacian equations for every m>=k+1, k>=3, n>=2. All edge-current classes are counted, the sole sign switch is p-n, and algebraic subtraction gives the two rational corrections. Strict comparisons show that clique-edge columns never maximize. Exact threshold and upper-bound inequalities hold over the entire domain. A stdlib exact rational checker verified 5712 orbit instances and 1013 complete columns reconstructed from 23 grounded Laplacian inverses; finite checks support but do not replace the complete proof.

value.rationale: A natural clique perturbation of complete bipartite transportation graphs yields an all-parameter exact pair of Banach projection invariants. Unlike the single inserted edge, unbounded clique size creates two strictly separated maximizing-edge thresholds for every n>=5, k>=3 and new sharp family-wide amplification suprema 4 and 5. The phase interval is guaranteed to contain integer examples for each (n,k), furnishing a structural phenomenon that is not a small numerical increment or mere tabulation.
